args.title: Reassess authenticated Exodus seed payload semantics for any Q1 contact linkage
args.why: s42120103 asks me to handle semantic parsing while L-73 is limited to source-derived framing/padding. My L-72 found no literal contact indicators; this distinct route will read the existing authenticated seed plaintext with bounded binary structure checks for a specific contact linkage, without repeat-decrypting candidates or exposing wallet secret values.

routes.method: Read the retained authenticated seed plaintext in a secret_output job; examine printable runs, recognized container/object framing, and candidate contact-specific data schema without emitting plaintext or key material.
Read static application-source strings only for documented seed-plaintext structure/consumer relationships; do not execute recovered code and distinguish source strings from data linkage.

args.overlap_why: L-73 is explicitly limited to original-source framing/padding. This route inspects the already authenticated seed payload's data semantics with content suppressed; it does not repeat its decryption, storage-key testing, or framing analysis.
